title: Ankon Projects Universe
shortDescription: Primary portfolio command center with cinematic UI, animated nav, and premium motion system.
longDescription: Ankon Projects Universe is the flagship portfolio platform with App Router architecture, motion-first interactions, and modular component structure for rapid expansion.

title: Ankon Futuristic Utility Hub
shortDescription: Premium tool ecosystem with glassmorphism cards, live search, and expandable locked modules.
longDescription: A modular tools hub designed for growth. It includes live tools and styled locked placeholders so new utilities can ship without redesigning the layout.

title: Ankon Premiume Optimizer C++
shortDescription: Premium software drop page with cinematic preview art and direct package download.
longDescription: Dedicated release experience for Ankon Premiume Optimizer C++ with high-impact visuals, focused call-to-action, and downloadable archive delivery from the site.

title: Quantum QR Forge
shortDescription: Advanced QR generator with size, color, correction-level controls and PNG export.
longDescription: Quantum QR Forge provides live QR rendering with custom colors and export utilities for practical sharing, marketing, and profile links.

title: Nebula Link Shortener
shortDescription: Client-side short link generator with copy/open actions and persistent history.
longDescription: Nebula Link Shortener supports local code mapping, history tracking, quick sharing, and browser-based redirect flow via dynamic routes.

title: Photon Image Compressor
shortDescription: In-browser image compression tool with quality slider and preview comparison.
longDescription: Photon Image Compressor runs fully on-device using canvas APIs, enabling fast compression without uploading user files to a server.

title: Prism Palette Lab
shortDescription: Color palette utility for generating and copying cinematic color sets quickly.
longDescription: Prism Palette Lab helps generate production-ready color families from a base tone and supports fast copy workflows for design implementation.

title: Syntax JSON Forge
shortDescription: Fast JSON validator/formatter/minifier for API payload workflows.
longDescription: Syntax JSON Forge is a utility for developers to validate, prettify, minify, and copy JSON with immediate feedback.

title: Markdown Command Deck
shortDescription: Markdown editor with live preview and export-ready writing flow.
longDescription: Markdown Command Deck provides a clean writing environment with instant preview and export support for quick documentation workflows.
